room_labels.question: 4. Room labels
room_labels.caveat: Tokens were selected by a name heuristic; confirm which are real room classes from the full class vocabulary in this report.

geometry_representation.question: 5. Coordinate / geometry representation
geometry_representation.caveat: Coordinates are SVG user units. Elements with a transform attribute are measured untransformed. No physical scale is asserted.

adjacency.question: 7. Can adjacency be derived?

evidence.criteria: CONFIRMED if room polygons parse in >= 90% of analyzed plans and near-touching rooms appear in >= 50% of those

adjacency.caveat: bbox near-touch, tolerance 1% of plan extent; approximate (L-shaped rooms may give false positives)

room_areas.question: 8. Can room areas be derived?
room_areas.caveat: Areas are in SVG units squared. Physical scale is not asserted; use proportions unless a scale is confirmed.

room_aspect_ratios.question: 9. Can room aspect ratios be derived?
room_aspect_ratios.caveat: Scale-free. Bounding-box aspect is reliable only for near-rectangular rooms (see rectangularity).

doors_windows.question: 10. Can doors / windows be derived?
doors_windows.caveat: Counts are labelled elements in the sample; geometry quality not yet assessed.

entrances.question: 11. Can entrances be derived?
entrances.caveat: A matched label may denote a ROOM (e.g. an entry room), not a door position.

stairs.question: 12. Can stairs be derived?
stairs.caveat: Counts are labelled elements in the sample; geometry quality not yet assessed.

parking_garage.question: 13. Can parking / garage be derived?
parking_garage.caveat: Counts are labelled elements in the sample; geometry quality not yet assessed.

multi_floor.question: 14. Is multi-floor information present?
multi_floor.caveat: Floor tokens in file names suggest several floors for some plans; verify they are distinct storeys.

reliable_priors.question: 15. Which features are reliable enough to use as priors?
reliable_priors.caveat: Candidates only: a human must confirm the class mapping before extraction.
